Zn supplementation of cows and calves grazing low-Zn forage increased calf weight gain but did not affect cow or calf reproductive efficiency.
supplemental Zn to grazing cow-calf pairs grazing mature dry range forage containing less that 20 ppm Zn did not increase calf growth rate, but did increase cow growth rate.
Zn supplementation of cows and calves grazing dry mature forage containing less that 20 ppm Zn did not affect calf growth or conception rate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
supplemental Zn is not necessary for cow-calf production when forage Zn is less than 20 ppn and the basal supplement contains 1% Zn.
